data.name: Aayina
data.long_meaning: Aayina is derived from the Arabic root word 'Ayn, which means 'eye'. Aayina refers to a mirror, a reflection or an image. It is also a feminine given name in the Arabic language. In Islamic tradition, the name Aayina is often used to evoke the image of the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) companions seeking guidance and wisdom from him, as a mirror reflects one's true self.
